character: An elderly kitsune, a slight stooped fox-featured man with silver-white fur thinning at the muzzle, large amber eyes, and several tails held low and untidy. His expression is mild and still, the gaze level. Gaunt and frail, hollow beneath the cheekbones. One hand is dark to the wrist with dried blood
wardrobe: a scholar's good grey robe and waistcoat, filthy and torn at the hem, covered edge to edge in small precise handwriting in dried rust-brown blood, columns of notes running down both sleeves and across the chest

full.framing: Full body standing portrait, three-quarter view, stooped and frail, a robe covered in handwritten notes in dried blood.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, silver-white fox features, large amber eyes, mild and calm, head and upper chest filling the frame.

scene.framing: Sitting cross-legged on the stone floor of a dim cell, bent over his own outstretched sleeve, writing tiny careful notes on the cloth with a fingernail dipped in blood, entirely absorbed and calm.
